listing.name: Discord Rich Presence
listing.summary: Ever wanted to show your friends you're playing a single player game right now so they don't spam invites to shitty multiplayer games? Yeah, introducing discord rich presence, shows up on discord for everyone with a nice icon and all.

description:
Ever wanted to show your friends you're playing a single player game right now so they don't spam invites to shitty multiplayer games?  
Yeah, introducing discord rich presence, shows up on discord for everyone with a nice icon and all.
The information provided is taken from the game dynamically.
Info available:

cmdr {yourplayername} level {yourlevel} | {flagship name} ({flagship class})
{currentLocalization}  - {ships In fleet amount } - {current credits}


[Download v1.0.0](https://github.com/andrzejsokolowski/starsector-discord-rich-presence/releases/latest) from github

Or

Forum link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35392.msg518784#msg518784
